content.text: The planner agrees with brute force and NetworkX. Now let me test the zstd capture path and capture bounds:

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tmp/test_capture.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, base64, io, csv
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
from harness import *
import zstandard as zstd
h=lambda n:'2001:db8:1:1200::%s'%n

rows=[icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo')]
payload=rows_to_csv(rows)

# zstd capture
job=base_job(leases=[lease()],queries=[10])
job['captures']=[capture(rows,encoding='zstd')]
out,_=run(job)
check('zstd capture', out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['internal']==[h('1')], out)

# zstd split across chunks mid frame
raw=zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(payload)
job['captures']=[{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[b64(raw[:5]),b64(raw[5:])]}]
out,_=run(job)
check('zstd split chunks', out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['internal']==[h('1')], out)

# zstd truncated -> capture error
job['captures']=[{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[b64(raw[:-3])]}]
out,_=run(job)
check('zstd truncated -> capture', out=={'error':'capture'}, out)

# zstd with checksum flag and skippable frame
comp=zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=3,write_checksum=True)
raw=comp.compress(payload)
skippable=bytes.fromhex('502a4d18')+(4).to_bytes(4,'little')+b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'
job['captures']=[{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[b64(skippable+raw)]}]
out,_=run(job)
check('zstd skippable frame', out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['internal']==[h('1')], out)

# corrupted checksum -> capture error
raw2=bytearray(raw); raw2[-1]^=0xff
job['captures']=[{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[b64(bytes(raw2))]}]
out,_=run(job)
check('zstd bad checksum -> capture', out=={'error':'capture'}, out)

# csv split across chunks mid record
job['captures']=[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[b64(payload[:20]),b64(payload[20:])]}]
out,_=run(job)
check('csv split chunks', out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['internal']==[h('1')], out)

# csv split mid code point
text=rows_to_csv([icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo')])
# quoted field with a non ascii character in a payload is not possible for tcp; use a comment style check
# instead check utf-8 decoding across chunk boundary using a reject reason: field with unicode
rows_u=[icmp('r1',1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo')]
rows_u.append(['icmp','r2','1','5','put','home','1','0/i1',h('1'),'','echo','','','\u00e9'])
payload_u=rows_to_csv(rows_u)
index=payload_u.index('\u00e9'.encode())
job['captures']=[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[b64(payload_u[:index+1]),b64(payload_u[index+1:])]}]
out,_=run(job)
check('csv split code point rejected row', out['rejected']==[[0,1]], out['rejected'])

# quoted field with newline
rows_q=[['icmp','r3','1','5','put','home','1','0/i1',h('1'),'','echo','','','a\nb']]
payload_q=rows_to_csv(rows_q)
job['captures']=[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[b64(payload_q)]}]
out,_=run(job)
check('quoted newline single record', out['rejected']==[[0,0]] and len(out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'])==3, (out['rejected'],out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']))

# too many records -> capture error
many=[icmp('r%d'%i,1,5,'home',1,'0/i1',h('1'),h('1'),'echo') for i in range(200001)]
job['captures']=[capture(many)]
out,_=run(job)
check('record budget -> capture', out=={'error':'capture'}, out)

# field too large -> capture error
big='x'*200000
job['captures']=[capture([['icmp','r1','1','5','put','home','1','0/i1',h('1'),'','echo','','',big]])]
out,_=run(job)
check('field budget -> capture', out=={'error':'capture'}, out)

# decoded byte budget
job['captures']=[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[b64(b'x'*(17*1024*1024)),b64(b'y'*(17*1024*1024))]}]
out,_=run(job)
check('decoded budget -> capture', out=={'error':'capture'}, out)
print('failures',globals().get('FAILURES',0))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 /workspace/tmp/test_capture.py
